_readme: sleepIn: the lady who shares Sam's bed in an Owner's Suite (Sam tab → Home). trust = minimum trust; weekly: trustGain, mood, rest (her energy), samRest (Sam's energy); eventChance = odds per week of an evening/morning proposal when she is eager.
Tuning numbers. Change them and reload; no code needed.

amenities: effect numbers for the house amenities (data/economy.json → upgrades has cost, upkeep and wording; amenitySize has the rooms). raceDraw = multiplier on that race's weight when candidates are rolled, while a Tethering Stone (spirit) or Charging Alcove (android) is built in ANY house. sigil.samDrain = share of the usual energy a demon takes from Sam in a house with the sigil. chapel: a Chapel Keeper (angels, 2 per house) adds rep (reputation, scaled by repGain) and pop (popularity) each week, gets mood and trust, visitorClass {class: x} = pilgrim / cleric clients raise visitors and donations: x (1 + sum of (that class's share of the week's courtesan clients) x (value - 1)), and visitors leave donations = visitors x donation x (0.5 + charm/100). garden: mood each week and rest multiplier (+5%) for everyone in the house, elves get elfMult times both. incense: mode calm or aphro (h.incense); calm.pushy = multiplier on pushy-client and incident chance, calm.lust / aphro.lust on weekly lust build, aphro.prop on propositions to staff; beastMult = how much stronger beastkin feel it (the factor's distance from 1 is multiplied by it); lewdDrop = points added to her lewdness for service-comfort checks under aphro (never stored). workshop.perDwarf = share of the build markup removed per dwarf in the house each week (h.wsDisc, max 1, reset on any purchase). laundry.decay = multiplier on weekly tidiness loss. drinks: per drinks tier (h.drinks 0-3) bar[] multiplies bartender income, props[] multiplies the bar's proposition boost (jobs.barProps) and upkeep[] is the weekly cost (needs the Bar). classroom: the teacher (job teacher) raises each other lady's skill in the subject by floor((hers below teacher) x rate), x humanMult for humans; teacherGrow = skill growth for the teacher, learnXP = Wits growth for each lady taught per week (the teacher gets 1.5), mood / trust = her weekly gains. decor: demand[tier] multiplies client demand, noble = extra weight for noble clients at the top tier, upkeep = gold per tier per week.

houses: priceStep = each house you already own beyond the first adds this share of the base price to the next house you buy (HOUSES[id].cost x (1 + priceStep x (owned - 1))). New Game+ new-house debt is not affected.
solo: energyCost = share of her max energy a solo night costs; clientCap = most clients she'll see that week afterward; lustDrop = how much it lowers her lust.

lovers: neglectWeeks = weeks in a row without Sam before she feels left out (when another lover isn't); missedMood = mood lost each week she's restless and Sam doesn't see her; jealousyChance = weekly odds of that event. Shared scenes are tuned in bonds.json.

breakup: mood / trust = what ending it costs her (Loyal ladies lose half the trust); rekindleTrust = trust she needs before Sam can ask her back; rekindleChance = base odds she says yes (better if she's happy); rekindleCooldown = weeks between attempts.
lust: low = below this she turns down the heavier services; eager = she's in the mood (bonuses below); high = 'restless' (solo nights, reckless nights, lovers come looking for Sam).

lust.build: weekly gain = base + lewdness*perLewd (+eagerTrait for Eager/Exhibitionist, +resting), times her personality's lustBuild and her lustBuild fx (races, traits: data/races.json, data/traits.json).

lust.drop: how much each thing lowers it right away: private = private time with Sam, train = practicing with Sam. Client services now use the per-service 'lust' value in services.json (x technique etc.); client/fav here are the legacy fallback for services without one. Giving services, kisses and massages build lust only with Sam (with clients, only for ladies with the svcLustBuild fx, e.g. Insatiable). Lewder ladies drop less per act (dropAtLewd0 → dropAtLewd100). samRelease: Sam's private time and practice spend drop.private / drop.train x (min + (max-min) x his Technique/100).
lust.profile.floorPerLewd: her lust never falls below lewdness × this (a very lewd lady is never fully sated).
Insatiable / Slow to Warm and the race multipliers are now fx in data/traits.json and data/races.json (lustBuild, lustDrop, lustFloor, lustMax). lust.traitChance = odds a generic lady has the trait.
lust.bonus: extra mood/trust from private time with Sam when she's eager or restless (trainMult scales it for practice sessions); clientMood = mood per client service while eager.

renewal: her willingness = (trust×0.6 + mood×0.4)/100 (+loyal for Loyal ladies). At freeAt or above she re-signs for free; below that the fee scales up toward feeWeeks × her wage; below refuseBelow she's thinking of leaving and may say no. raise = size of the raise option; raiseBoost = how much it helps her willingness.

wages: contracts renew at her current going rate (wageFor, which rises with her skills and popularity). Between renewals she asks for a raise once her wage falls below askAt × her going rate (askAtAmbitious for Ambitious/Greedy).
mood: restingPoint = the mood she drifts back toward each week (drift = how fast); overworkAt = how many clients a week before she feels overworked.
income.escort: multiplier on all escort and off-duty service fees.

demolish: share = fraction of an item's base price (no inflation) it costs to demolish a built amenity, or the last bedroom / staff quarters above the house's starting count. Frees the space, lowers h.spent by the base price, never refunds. Built-in amenities can't be demolished; neither can the Bathhouse, Stage or Bar while someone holds the job that needs it.

ngplus: New Game+ (after paying off the debt). Sam always keeps his home house; his starter houses (S.starters: the first house plus the new house taken each cycle) and any house whose story is finished are kept by default but the player can surrender them on the Houses step (NGS.keep) (rooms, tier, upgrades, beds); other houses are sold for saleValue x their price (0 = surrendered), which reduces the new debt instead of adding gold. New debt = home house debt x debtShare x (1 + perCycle for each cycle after the second) + improvementsValue x improveShare (improvementsValue = gold spent on rooms, tiers, quarters, beds, annex and upgrades in all kept houses, tracked in h.spent). purse = Sam's starting gold (same as a new game; his savings stay behind; the Deep Pockets perk adds 2,500). samReset: stats = Sam keeps his level but his stats are rebuilt as sam.base + sam.perLevel x (level-1) + his past lives; appraisal = Appraisal level and XP start over (past lives such as otaku re-apply their floor). Only Devoted lovers come along (they draw wages again, stats reset: named ones to their data values, generic ones to 50%, popularity 0, trust and lewdness back to where they started: named from data, generic from when they were rolled, else baseTrust/baseLewd) and each picks one NG+ perk (traits.json ngPerk). NG+ houses (economy.json ngplus) and NG+ partners (characters.json ngplus) only appear from cycle 2; NG+ houses are bought during the cycle.Sam also takes a new house each cycle (houseOffers deeds, no premium ones; its debt x newHouseShare x (1 + perCycle for each cycle after the second) joins the new debt; its resident comes along) and may add one more past life (economy.json pasts, each once). reborn: every lady who carries over gains a stack of the Reincarnated perk (w.reborn): trust gain x (1 + trust x stacks), skill gain x (1 + skill x stacks), stat gain x (1 + stat x stacks), lewdness gain x (1 + lewd x stacks). friends: old friends: non-lover guests (guests) and generic ladies (generics) whose trust is at least trust (0-100 internal, 100 = maxed) also get a Reincarnated stack but no perk, and wait in S.alumni; each weekly candidate refresh one of them turns up among the candidates with probability chance (extra to the normal candidates, at most max at a time, and she stays until hired). The first NG+ week always shows one.

svc: per-service rules. staminaEnergy = services whose services.json stats list stamina cost her energy x (1.1 - stamina/500) on top of the usual stamina discount (false = off). tech* = the range of a client's technique; frustrateAt = a finishing service leaves her frustrated when technique x (her lust/60) is below this (her lust rises by frustrateLust). encore* = chance (+ her encore fx) and fee share of a reckless lady's second round. race* = enthusiast / put-off clients (data/races.json client). demon: demons don't sleep: each working week costs them hunger energy, and they gain energy per finishing service (feed, or feedReckless when restless, which costs house reputation repDrain unless the house has a Binding Sigil); with Sam she gains samGain and Sam loses samExtra more energy. android: recharge fee (fee + perEnergy x energy restored; the Charging Alcove takes chargerDiscount off). refusalMood = beastkin mood loss when Sam turns down a restless request (a Grooming Den halves it).

jobs: barAgil = bartender income x (1 + barAgil x Agility/100), i.e. up to +10% more visitors served. attendantWitsW (was attendantRefW) = Wits weight of an attendant. courtesanTh = how many points lower a courtesan's comfort lines sit; propWant = chance a client asks for a service (courtesans vs. everyone else who steps in); promoter draw = promoterBase + (charm+service)/promoterDiv clients, samples multiply it (samplesDraw), cost samplesEnergy energy, and she gives samplesMin-samplesMax light services from her client menu for free (kiss, massage, hands, breasts, mouth; half energy, no fee or room; shown in the report; samplesLust lust if none fit), rep change = (quality-0.5) x samplesRep; attendant: courtesans spend attendantEnergy x energy and clients are attendantSat happier; a house can have as many attendants as courtesan positions, and each courtesan with her own attendant (most popular first) gets attendantOwnMood mood and attendantOwnTrust trust a week; madame: cuts the house's mood losses to madameMoodLoss, matches clients to a fitting lady (+madameMatchSat sat), and coaches courtesans she out-ranks by madamePopGap popularity: each skill she is better at grows by madameCoach x the difference (rounded down); stepIn* = how many clients a madame/attendant takes when courtesans are swamped and the energy she needs; bar*: each active bartender (max barPropsMax) with a Bar raises the house proposition rate by barProps (x amenities.drinks.props[h.drinks]; applies to propositions to staff and to the share of clients who ask a courtesan for a service), and adds rowdy chance (barRowdy) and client recklessness (barReckless); a bartender earns (barBase + visitors x barPerVisitor) x skill/charm x amenities.drinks.bar[h.drinks], plus tips = visitors x barTips x (0.5 + popularity/100) x (0.5 + charm/100); bath*: massage offers to bathers (bathShare of visitors, bathCap each); tipsBase / danceRep: dancer tips and reputation. promoterBase/promoterDiv: promoter draw = base + (Charisma + Hospitality)/div; x (1 + promoterLowRep x (1 - rep/promoterRepRef)) while the house is little known; the 2nd/3rd promoter x promoterStack^k; each drawn client also spreads the name (repAdd promoterRep x draw).
rooms.perRoom: room-service sessions per bedroom per week; Exhibitionist ladies don't use a room.

tidy: maidPerAgil = extra tidiness per point of the maid's Agility (0-100; an agility-50 maid adds about 8% over an average one). starting value, losses (perService room service, perVisitor), maid gain per week = (maidBase + service skill x maidPerSkill) x outfit bonus x her tidy fx, and the three effect tiers (rep per week, mood, energy recovery multiplier) at high (>=75), low (<45) and bad (<20). maidEase/maidMax: a maid's weekly gain is x (100 - tidiness)/maidEase (at most maidMax), so maids hold a house around a level instead of pinning it at 100: one average maid keeps a 6-8 lady house near 70. Bands: high (>= high) small bonus, neutral up to there, low (< low), bad (< bad) costs reputation, mood, rest and client satisfaction (fx.*.sat).
rep: positive reputation changes are scaled by max(gainMin, gainBase - rep/gainDiv). Losses are not.

props: propositions. talkDown = pushy-client chance she talks him down herself before security is tried: (Wits x .6 + Charm x .4)/100 x talkDown; talkMood = her mood change when she has to (negative). penalty/maxPenalty = main-job output lost per accepted proposition (non-must jobs). accept* = chance a non-must lady accepts (acceptBase + (lust-acceptLustMid)/100 + willing fx, +acceptEager when eager, +acceptReckless when reckless); onChance / offSlip = chance when "Open to propositions" is on / off-but-reckless; alt / altMust = chance of a counter-offer. attendantExpect = share of attendant propositions where the client expected her to offer (expectSat if she declines). self* = reckless ladies propositioning clients. Pushy resolution: security power vs a roll in securityRoll; else Sam (if his energy >= samEnergyMin) checks strength + charm/2 + roll(0..samRoll) >= samCheck; else none. Costs/mood effects follow. When security fails a pushy client and Sam has the energy, he is sent for and the player decides after the report (one event for the week): step in (the old samCheck roll), call the town watch (watchFee per incident, watchRep reputation each), or let her handle it (none penalties). nights: nights in a working week. A pushy client nobody stops (Sam too tired, or his step-in fails) ends her night: escorts lose nightCap clients of the week, everyone else 1/nights of her job's output and that share of the week's propositions. Sam steps in on the spot when he has samEnergyMin energy (Strength + Charm/2 + samRoll vs samCheck, +watchBonus if he stood watch); there is no more after-report event.

houseGate: ladies who come with a house (role 'house') can't trust Sam past base + perBeat x (that house's story beat) until the house story is finished (3 beats: 40 + 20 x 3 = 100). Arc beats for them wait for the story too. gap = weeks before beat 1 / 2 / 3 can start (first, later, later); retry = weeks before a beat comes back after a failed check.
wardrobe: costMult scales every outfit/underwear price (lower = easier to get clothes). eventChance = relative weight of each of the 'someone gave her an outfit' random events (data/events.json).

svc.askMore: after a service that builds her lust (giving, kissing, massages), a lady with lust >= lust.eager and lewdness >= lewd may ask the client for more (chance), offering a heavier service from her menu that spends lust; it pays fee x its normal price.

svc.demon: kissFeed = energy a demon draws from a client's kiss; kissSam (+ kissSamDraw when she's eager, costing Sam kissSamCost extra) from Sam's. restDrainChance / restRepDrain: a restless demon on her week off may drain some poor man in town (town reputation loss; a Demon Sigil doesn't help outside). studCost / studGain / studLust: Sam pays for a stud for the night (sheet button, once a week).

again: after a visit or encounter, a lady who is still worked up may want another round (chance by race, other = everyone else except spirits, + her encore fx; beastkin only need to be eager, others nearly restless). samCost = Sam's energy; mood = her mood gain (twice for beastkin). Once a week each. Ladies who come to Sam because they are restless only pick services that spend lust (releaseSamAct).

sam: Sam's house-wide actions. roundsTrust / roundsMood = what Making the rounds gives every lady (trust is 0-100 here, so 0.4 shows as 4); lessonShare = share of a one-on-one training gain that each lady in a lesson gets. base = Sam's starting stats in a new game (and the base for the NG+ rebuild); perLevel = each stat gained per level (samGainXP).
lewd: lewdness gains go through lewdUp(w, n, cap) (character.js): see its _note. Dates add their own caps (dates.json lewdCap, spicy cap).
jobs.bathJoinLewd / bathJoinFee: a bath attendant comfortable with massages and at least this lewd joins bathers in the water (bath massage, x fee), and may ask for more like anyone else.

debt: 'payments' payments every 'every' weeks from when the debt started (NG+ restarts it). Payment n = total x share_n; shares ramp linearly from 1 to 'ramp' (the last is ramp x the first) and sum to 1, so there is no balloon; the last payment clears whatever remains (penalties included). A missed payment adds penalty x its amount to the debt and carries over to the next; 'strikes' misses end the game. debt.ngplus: New Game+ loans are due sooner: each cycle past the first has 'fewer' fewer payments (never below minPayments) and a ramp lowered by 'flatter' (never below minRamp), so the early payments are bigger; ngBegin stores the plan in S.debt.payments/ramp.
clients: pickier customers as a house gets famous: satisfaction loses (effective reputation - pickFrom) x pickPer.

quarters: staff expect better lodging as the house gets famous: expected comfort = floor(house rep / repPerLevel), max 3; comfort = min(bed level, bedroom refurbishment tier). Each level short costs moodPer mood a week (not for ladies who don't sleep, nor those already on the floor).

arcs: romance arcs. need[i] = trust for beat i, gap[i] = weeks since her last beat. Extras: beat 2 needs a date or private time with Sam, dates['4'] dates for beat 4, private['5'] private times for beat 5.

ngplus.carry: share of what a carried lady (lover or old friend) gained in stats, job skills and service skills above her starting values that she keeps into the next cycle; Sam keeps the same share of his training/story stat gains. Ladies keep more with each life: carryPer x the life she is entering (her 2nd life 20%, 3rd 30%...), at most carryMax, never below carry. rebornWage: each Reincarnated stack raises her wage by this share (wageFor). ngplus.cap: stats and skills top out at base + perCycle x (cycle-1) (ladies 1000, 1100, 1200...; Sam's 0-100 stats use a tenth of that). Trust, lewdness, mood, energy and health are unaffected.

feast: Throw a feast (house tab), once per house per week, no action. Each tier: cost per lady in that house, trust (0-100 scale, still capped by house stories) and mood each lady gets. Wording is in each tier's text.

sam.bonus: Sam's stats (0-100) also work passively, scaled by stat/100: charm = extra share of trust every lady gains, business = extra share of weekly house income, security = Strength x this added to every house's security, rest = extra share of his weekly recovery at Strength 100, wits = extra share of stat training and Appraisal XP. energyPerCycle: Sam's max energy is 100 + this x (cycle-1). Sam gains +1 action every 5 levels.

samHome: Sam sleeps in one house (S.samHome, default his home house). His weekly recovery (weekly) and naps (nap) scale with that house's staff bed quality: x rest/ref (economy.json beds). Late-night encounters only come from ladies in his house unless he has a 'reach' upgrade or boon. samUps: things Sam can buy (Sam tab); carry = kept in New Game+; fx: bedTier (+tiers for Sam's own bed), weekly (+energy every week), reach (ladies from every house can visit him at night); tool fx (summed by samUpFx, each boosts one Sam-tab action): bartend (+share of Tend bar income), watch (+share of Stand watch security), books (extra upkeep cut, as a fraction, on top of Do the books), rounds (+share of Make the rounds trust and mood), lesson (+share of Hold a lesson skill gains), scout (+candidates from Scout recruits). Sam's Owner's Suite is a house amenity (economy.json → upgrades.suite): +1 bed tier when he sleeps in that house.

clients.traits: cheat (Cheapskate) = share of the fee penalty the lady's Wits cancels at 100 (fee 0.8, cheat 0.5: 0.8 at wits 0 to 0.9 at wits 100). Every client (not regulars) rolls 1-3 traits (clients.traitCount = odds of 1/2/3), weighted by w x his class's traits weight (economy.json → classes.traits), skipping excl. hidden: not shown in the report. Keys (all optional): prop (x his chance to want a service / proposition staff), pushy (+ chance he won't take no), pushyMult (x that), rowdy (+ house incident pressure), booze {prop, pushy, rowdy, patience} (added while a bartender works, x (1 + drinks tier x boozeDrinks)), tips (x bar tips), fee (x what he pays), compFee (x when he only wants company), qualityFee [a,b] (fee x (a + quality x b)), selfAccept (+ chance he says yes to a restless lady), likes {races ('beastkin:<sub>' ok), traits (lady traits), restless} with like (enthusiast chance) and draw (pick weight; without a madame only x^nativeMatch), patience (+ chance to wait), open (+ openness to a host's warm-up), thirsty (always wants a service; unserved: thirsty.sat and thirsty.rep), acceptHost (chance he'd rather the host finish him than wait), tech (+ his technique), satAdd (+ satisfaction), hostLike (x host satisfaction bonus), jobProp {job: x his propositions to that job}, stageSpend (x stage spending while waiting), gossip (x his rep effect, clients.gossip.rep per point of satisfaction away from 50), regular (x chance he becomes a regular). stats {stat: weight} = stat taste (see clients.statPref); charmGate {at, below, above} = satisfaction below if her Charm (0-100) is under at, else above; wantStats {stats, mult} = x his chance to ask for a service whose services.json stats include any of them. Client traits never reach image prompts or AI text.

clients.statPref: stat tastes (`stats` on client traits and on economy.json classes; regulars keep their class taste). Score = weighted average of clamp((her stat 0-100 - 50)/50, -0.5, 1), 0 = nothing preferred. draw: x (1 + draw x score) on his pick weight (madame match and free choice); sat: + sat x score satisfaction; fee: x (1 + fee x score) on the main service fee (this is what makes Nobles pay for Refinement). Never used in AI text, image prompts or encounter entries.

clients.nativeMatch: without a madame clients mostly take whoever is free: appeal and race/trait draw count only to this power. clients.wait: with a madame, a client whose best match is busy (chance (load - busyAt) / (1 - busyAt), load = her clients so far / her weekly cap of 10, so nobody is busy before busyAt) waits with chance base + his patience + house comfort (garden, decorPer x decor tier, tidy when tidy, bath, open bar, open stage, hostPer x working hosts), capped at max; waiting costs sat (a host offsets it); else he takes someone else, or leaves (leaveSat) if nobody is free. Waiting clients spend barSpend at an open bar / stageSpend at a staffed stage. clients.host: sat is x (0.6 + her Charm/125); each host entertains perWeek x (1 + service skill/100 x skillPer x 10) waiting clients per week (x outfit/job bonus x her output after accepted propositions; each accepted proposition costs propCost, a warm-up or entertaining 1 each), +sat (+satSkill x quality); clients at least fluffOpen open (0.3 + the open of his traits) get a warm-up (her menu or what she is comfortable with, from kiss / massage / manual / oral / breast give; not if she is set to Off) (a light service in the open, never finished): +fluffSat (+fluffSkill x quality) on his courtesan visit, tip fluffFee x service price, at most fluffMax per client; a client with acceptHost may have her finish him instead (finishShare of a normal fee, costs finishCost of her capacity); accepted propositions cost propCost. thirsty / gossip: see clients.traits.

ngplus.bonds: when two ladies both reincarnate (carried lovers, old friends, or alumni still waiting to be re-hired), their bond carries into the next cycle at keep x its value (0.5 = halved; 1 = untouched; 0 = reset), and its kind (mentor, comrades, ...) stays unless kinds is false. The sheet marks such bonds '(from a past life)'. Bonds with anyone else are dropped as before.

jobs.attendant*: an attendant's quality = (Hospitality x attendantSkillW + Charm x attendantCharmW + Wits x attendantWitsW)/100 x outfit/job bonus x her output, capped at attendantQMax (an average attendant is about 0.5, a top one 1+). The most popular courtesans each get their own attendant (best attendant first); the others share attendantShared x the average quality. A courtesan's service energy cost x (1 - help x attendantEnergyPer, never below attendantEnergyMin) and her clients' satisfaction + help x attendantSatPer; her own attendant also gives her attendantOwnMood / attendantOwnTrust x (0.5 + quality/2). Low-skill attendants mostly just step in when the courtesans are swamped.

amenities.classroom (teaching formula): each lady behind the teacher gains floor(gap x rate x teacher x learner). teacher = (base + Management/100 x manageW + Wits/100 x witsW) x outfit/job bonus (teacher) x her teach fx x her output; learner = (learnBase + Wits/100 x learnWits) x her learn fx (x humanMult for humans). An average teacher and learner come to about 1. The madame's coaching (jobs.madameCoach) also uses her teach fx and the learner's learn fx.

tutor: paid tutoring per lady (her sheet → Tutoring; js/logic/spending.js). Each week at the week's end Sam pays cost (x tier cost, x 1 + perCycle x (cycle-1)) for every lady with a tutor; skipped with a report note if the purse can't cover it. focus weak = her `weakStats` lowest stats (by statOf) at stat each and her `weakSkills` lowest trade skills at skill each; focus job = the stats her job uses (train.stat.byJob weights) at stat x weight, her job's skill at skill, other skills x others, and for menu jobs every menu service at svc. All gains x tier gain x her learn fx and personality 'train' liking. herEnergy = her energy per week; counts toward counts.lessons.

gifts: buying gifts for trust (her sheet → Gifts). tiers {cost, trust, mood}: trust goes through gainTrust (diminishing near the top, house-story caps still apply), mood x personality 'gift' liking (Greedy x greedy). Each gift to the same lady in one week costs x (1 + weekStep x gifts so far this week); cost x (1 + perCycle x (cycle-1)). beforeDebt: 'locked' (only once the debt is paid), 'action' (before that, each gift costs one of Sam's actions and energy; free after) or 'free'. Counts as a gift (counts.gifts).

goddess: the overarching story (js/logic/goddess.js, wording in data/goddess.json, docs/GODDESS.md). fullReborn = Reincarnated stacks that count as fully reincarnated (max carry); the binding comes at the first rebirth after a lady has lived such a life (reborn > fullReborn). events: before the binding, chance per week = base + perCycle x (cycle-1), at most max, at least gap weeks apart; bound = chance of a jealous remark after the binding (x 0.5 + jealousy/100). jealousy 0-100: perHire per new lady, perPrivate per private moment with someone else, perLady per lady past rosterRef, -decay weekly, perLover x lovers carried + perCycle at each rebirth before the binding, nightCut/talkCut when Sam spends time with her; mid/high = text tiers. love 0-100: bind (at the binding), night, talk; stay = love needed for her to stay at full divinity. mood: drifts toward base + love x perLove - jealousy x perJealous; below ignoreBelow she half the time ignores your guidance. divinity 0-max: bindTo after the binding, +finish per night, 1 action + 1 per perAction. power = (base + perDiv x divinity) x (1 + perReborn x (fully reborn ladies + their lives past full)). actions: indulge (ladies with the most lust: lust off, mood, energy, lewd), business (income share and rep in a random house), watch (chance she stops each pushy client in the house with the most trouble, max), tutelage (the least skilled working lady: job skill + a stat), whim (random of those x mult), claim (jealousy/per chance per action: she keeps Sam up (samEnergy) or monopolizes a new lady (mood)). night: AP + cost energy; a finishing tier-3 service (inside her) gives Sam restore + perDiv x divinity energy, +divinity.finish, love.night, mood; finishing outside: half the energy, love.outside, outsideMood; no finish: -noneLove, -noneMood. neglect: from `after` weeks without a night, -love/-mood every week; a jealous claim on a lady with no night within claimWeeks: -claimLove/-claimMood. indulge.practice = service skill the lady gains.

lewd._note: Lewdness diminishing returns (lewdUp). Each source has a cap: full gain below cap-band, half at the cap, none past cap+band. Services: cap = service th + capOver. softCap: default cap for sources without one; past it only daring dates, traits and stories push her further.

startLewd._note: Generic ladies' starting lewdness: min + span x r^pow (r uniform 0-1). pow > 1 skews low. Race/sub mods still add on top.

train._note: One-on-one training on her sheet (samTrain), no pickers. stat: Sam coaches every stat her job uses (stat.byJob weights, default for jobs not listed); each gains (base + Sam Wits x perWits) x Wits bonus x weight x spread (0-1000 units, diminishing near the cap). skill: every trade skill; her job's skill (Hospitality without one) gets the full gain, the others x others; scales with Technique; no lust or lewdness. service: practice of every service she does with Sam (canSam), each (base + Technique x perTech) x share; warms her up (svcLust x her lewdness, lewd lewdness while her lewdness is below lewdCap). broad: jobs that learn a bit of everything (madame, teacher): stats not in their list at weight stat, other skills at skillOthers instead of skill.others, and in classes every other skill at lesson x the class gain. energy = Sam's, herEnergy = hers. skill.base/perTech: her job's skill gains base + Technique x perTech per session (others x others); herEnergy kept low so a session pays back within a cycle (tools/lab sam-actions-campaign).

trust._note: Trust is 0-100 here (shown to the player x10, out of 1000). minor = the least any time with Sam builds (practice, private time, anything that gave none).

jobPrefs._note: Rolled job likes/dislikes for generic ladies (and named ones without their own list). Each job's odds: base, plus personality (personalities.json jobsUp/jobsDown), plus trait for each matching trait below, plus ownJob for the job she arrives in. maxLikes/maxDislikes cap the lists.

tiers.label: Family supper
tiers.text: Sam cooks (badly) and buys the rest (well). {house} eats together for once. Nobody talks about work.

tiers.label: Banquet
tiers.text: Roast, three kinds of pie and a cask of something sweet. The {house} staff toast Sam twice and mean it once.

tiers.label: Grand feast
tiers.text: Musicians, a hired cook and a cake taller than Sam. {house} talks about it for weeks.

coffee.label: Otherworld Coffee Maker
coffee.desc: He rebuilt a drip machine from memory and two dwarven pipes. +10 energy every week.

circle.label: Teleport Circle
circle.desc: A chalk circle in every house that the Credit House does not know about. Ladies from any of his houses can find Sam at night. Left behind in New Game+.

kit.label: Bartender's Kit
kit.desc: Proper shakers, a good knife, a bar towel with a history. Tend bar earns x1.3.

whistle.label: Watchman's Whistle
whistle.desc: Loud enough to end an argument two streets away. Stand watch gives x1.5 security.

ledger.label: Enchanted Ledger
ledger.desc: It adds itself up and sulks when the sums are wrong. Do the books cuts upkeep a further 10 percentage points.

notebook.label: Little Black Notebook
notebook.desc: Everyone's favorite tea, birthdays and grudges, all in one place. Make the rounds gives x1.5 trust and mood.

chalkboard.label: Slate Chalkboard
chalkboard.desc: Big enough for the back row and the handouts. Hold a lesson gives x1.3 skill gains.

pass.label: Guild Hall Pass
pass.desc: The clerk waves Sam straight to the good noticeboard. Scout recruits finds +1 candidate.

samCloth._note: Pictures of time with Sam roll how undressed she is each time (samSceneCloth): every level from the service minimum (never fully dressed when more is possible) up to what she is comfortable with, by these weights; her top level counts double. Each level, outfit and underwear set saves its own picture.

lessons._note: Sam's classes (Sam tab; each costs an action). stat: everyone working trains the stats her job uses at share x a one-on-one gain. skill: everyone working learns her job's skill (sam.lessonShare). demo: a demonstration with a partner Sam picks: she has to be open to it (lewdness >= openLewd, or Exhibitionist; never Modest) and does her favorite or furthest service with him (privateCore); everyone else watching learns that service (watchSkill x a practice gain) and warms up (watchLust x her lewdness, watchLewd lewdness up to that service's client line). The partner's demos count (counts.demos) toward Exhibitionist.

orgy._note: A night with several ladies at once (Sam tab → Gather the girls; orgyMenu/samOrgy in sam.js). One action; Sam's energy = perGirl x ladies (+ ramp x ladies x (ladies-1)/2 if you want later ladies to cost more). min-max ladies, all from one house unless Sam has reach (Teleport Circle / Shadow Clone). Each lady needs a service she does with Sam (bestSamAct, through privateCore: her usual private-time effects, lust spent), to be open to sharing (lewdness >= openLewd, Exhibitionist, or lust >= eager), not Modest, and energy >= minEnergy. Every pair: bond + bond. Each: lewdness + lewd (up to her service's Sam line + lewdCapPlus), mood + mood; counts.orgies.
